Resubmission preparation: selected replacement version 1.0.0 (41) includes the reviewer-plan access fix and platform-specific App Store cancellation text. Six physical iPhone screenshots are uploaded and delivery-state complete. Five await replacement with recaptures addressing a status-bar artefact and a missing location label. This draft has not been resubmitted. Final native purchase and entitlement verification is still pending.

Fan Sphere now has five tabs: Home, Discover, Game Day, Clips and Profile. The former tournament tab and event-pass offering have been retired.

Use the sign-in credentials saved separately in App Review Information. The demo account has full feature access; this does not represent a purchased subscription or a completed sandbox transaction.

Purchase review in the replacement build:
1. Profile > Subscription > Plans.
2. Tap See Home Team for Home Team, or See MVP for MVP.
3. Select Monthly or Annual in the sheet. The store supplies local price and billing period.
4. Tap Start 7-Day Free Trial (Home Team, subject to store eligibility) or Subscribe (MVP) to open the native purchase flow.
5. Restore Purchases is on Subscription. Manage Subscription opens Apple subscription settings.

Current auto-renewable product IDs: home_team_monthly_499, home_team_annual_3499, mvp_monthly_1499, mvp_annual_9999. Legacy premium and event-pass products are not the current offering. Public watch parties, group joining, RSVPs and clip viewing do not require a paid plan.

App walkthrough: Home for games and your groups; Discover for communities and watch parties; Game Day for schedules; Clips for short videos; Profile for account and subscriptions. The three American-football practice demos credit their licensed Mixkit sources and are not NFL game highlights.
